content: Government-led initiatives aimed at provisioning nationwide Wi-Fi and universal internet access underscore a systemic, state-supported drive toward comprehensive digital inclusion [115] . While these national plans often lack immediate, hyper-local specificity, they create a highly supportive macroeconomic backdrop that mitigates investment risk for private internet service providers looking to expand their local footprints.
